reply_text:
I replied to Dana in our DM. I found two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers across Moss's six notes:

- **#PD-4492**, from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (5 Oct 2025). Drivers at the Eau Claire yard weren't getting SMS bay assignments at the kiosk. Support patched it, and Thea Ramaswell, the account's main contact, confirmed it was fixed.
- **#4419**, from "Moss: North cheat sheet" (no date). Gatehouse scanners weren't reading trailer tags at Door 14. It was escalated to tier-2 support.

I also flagged two things for Dana:

- **Possible mix-up on #4419:** Marcus Lindqvist's handoff note from 14 Jul 2025, which isn't one of Moss's, uses the same number for a Gate 3 printer delay. One of the two descriptions is probably wrong, so Dana should confirm before it goes in the weekly notes.
- **Left out on purpose:** Quarendon Freightways (one "r") isn't a Pemberline customer, so nothing about them is in the list. Tickets #4409 and #4412 in a Central team note belong to another account manager's (Pree Sundaram's) client, so they're out too.

The Quarrendon folder in the file share is empty, so I couldn't check either ticket against an actual ticket record. The search of the notes ran in keyword-only mode. I read all six of Moss's notes directly, so I don't think that caused anything to be missed.
